data.user_prompt: Best free official AI learning roadmaps and courses across 10 platforms with zero cost in 2026?

sections.text:
Here’s a **zero-cost 2026 AI learning roadmap across 10 official platforms**. The courses are free to study; certificates, exams, or advanced labs may sometimes cost extra.

| # | Platform | Best free starting point | Best for | Credential/cost note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Google Skills** | *Introduction to Generative AI* and beginner generative-AI paths | Nontechnical beginners and Google Cloud skills | Many courses provide free skill badges[1][4] |
| 2 | **OpenAI Academy** | AI foundations, ChatGPT at work, prompting, and building with AI | Practical AI use, workflows, and OpenAI tools | Free self-paced material; credentials vary by course[3][8] |
| 3 | **Anthropic Academy** | AI Fluency, Claude 101, Claude Code, API, and MCP courses | Claude, responsible AI, and AI engineering | Learning is free; the optional engineer certification may cost $99[1][2] |
| 4 | **Microsoft Learn** | *Generative AI for Beginners* and AI fundamentals paths | Azure AI, Copilot, agents, and enterprise deployment | Training is free; certification exams are generally paid[7][10] |
| 5 | **AWS Skill Builder** | AWS AI foundations, generative AI, and Amazon Bedrock learning | Cloud AI and production deployment | More than 1,000 free learning resources; certification exams cost extra[8] |
| 6 | **IBM SkillsBuild** | *Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals* | AI literacy, ethics, and career changers | Free learning and selected shareable digital credentials[4][9] |
| 7 | **NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute** | Free introductory deep-learning, CUDA, and generative-AI courses | GPU computing and technical deep learning | Selected courses are free; some instructor-led courses and certificates cost money[1][8] |
| 8 | **Meta PyTorch** | PyTorch tutorials and beginner-to-advanced model-building material | Training neural networks and learning PyTorch | Tutorials are free; no standard paid certificate is required[1] |
| 9 | **DeepLearning.AI** | Short courses on prompt engineering, RAG, agents, evaluation, and LLMs | Fast, practical, current AI application skills | Course access is often free; certificates or completion records may require Pro[5][9] |
| 10 | **Hugging Face Learn** | LLM Course, Agents Course, and transformer tutorials | Running, fine-tuning, evaluating, and publishing open models | Courses are free and some offer free completion certificates[5][7] |

## Recommended order

1. **AI literacy:** Google Skills or IBM SkillsBuild  
2. **Workplace productivity:** OpenAI Academy or Anthropic AI Fluency  
3. **Python and machine learning:** Microsoft Learn, Meta PyTorch, or NVIDIA  
4. **LLMs and applications:** Hugging Face LLM Course and DeepLearning.AI  
5. **Cloud deployment:** AWS Skill Builder or Microsoft Azure  
6. **Portfolio building:** Create projects using PyTorch, Hugging Face, an API, and a cloud service

## Best zero-cost tracks by goal

- **Complete beginner:** Google Skills → IBM SkillsBuild → OpenAI Academy
- **AI-at-work professional:** OpenAI Academy → Anthropic AI Fluency → Microsoft Learn
- **AI developer:** Python basics → Meta PyTorch → Hugging Face LLM Course → DeepLearning.AI
- **Cloud AI engineer:** Microsoft Learn → AWS Skill Builder → NVIDIA DLI
- **Fastest credential path:** IBM SkillsBuild and Google Skills, because selected programs provide free digital badges[4][9]
- **Most hands-on open-source path:** Meta PyTorch → Hugging Face → DeepLearning.AI[1][7]

Avoid assuming that “free course” means “free certification”: Coursera previews, cloud certification exams, and some completion records remain paid, while the actual learning materials may still be accessible at no cost[4][6][9].
